why_the_nonce_matters: the nonce is what makes a turn's COMPLETION attestable to the dispatcher; without it ok=false and the used_* fields stay null, so a reader who trusts only those fields sees 'no arm'. The attempt record below them is the attribution surface.

optional_control_plane_improvement.change: populate used_rank/served_arm from the selected attempt record even when the nonce gate fails (or document attempts[] as the attribution contract)
optional_control_plane_improvement.friction: low - one assignment in the receipt builder near the nonce gate
optional_control_plane_improvement.authority: control-plane change, needs a WorkOrder; NOT needed to close TF-06 as recorded here
optional_control_plane_improvement.benefit: removes the recurring false 'unprovable arm' reading in every future round

round_2_effect: the R9 VERIFY dispatch should pin the mandated arm explicitly (--require-arm plus a rank binding) so a fallback cannot silently serve a verification turn; if rank 1 is unavailable this round, that is a model-availability finding to record rather than a reason to re-dispatch the same way
